context:
The planner measured it. All 253 Banchi decisions fail because the shared tool only reads a top-level title or a 'Ruling' section, and Banchi titles are one level down. No per-file edit fixes that: adding a 'Ruling' heading cuts each Banchi decision short, and changing the title level breaks about 20 Banchi readers and the merge tool's own number claim.
The 65 debts can be fixed in Banchi: 53 by script (add a 'What.' lead), 12 by hand.
Small extras either way: rewrite D218 and D245 to drop superseded text, reword D299's lead, rename the debt notes file to lowercase, and handle the two preamble files.

options.gain: 251 of 253 decisions work with no edit. Smallest total change.
options.how: A one-line change in claude-settings: read a second-level title when there is no top-level one, and skip files starting with '_'. Then a Sonnet workflow does the 65 debts and the extras in Banchi.
options.label: Fix the shared tool, then fan out in Banchi
options.lose: A change in another repo; every repo using the shared tool gets the fallback.

options.how: Move every decision title to top level and update about 20 readers, the merge claim, and decisions D60 and D160.
options.label: Change Banchi's titles instead
options.lose: Overturns how Banchi's decision files are built; large and risky.

options.label: Park the roll-out
options.lose: The waiting-page link file stays out of Banchi.

ref: item 91 (records roll-out), PR 966, claude-settings records page builder
title: Records roll-out: fix the shared tool to read Banchi's titles?
why: One line in the shared tool fixes 251 decisions; the Banchi-only route rewrites its record model.
